name: Neyagawa (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Neyagawa city emblem in purple: a ring divided by a vertical bar with pointed ends, like a stylised arrow.
history: Municipal flag of Neyagawa, a city in Osaka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 28 September 1984; the emblem dates from 3 May 1951.

features.role: Neyagawa city emblem — a ring divided by a vertical bar with pointed ends, like a stylised arrow
